# Wira

Wira is a WhatsApp AI agent for people who want a first personal agent without starting in a terminal or a new chat app. It runs on the buyer's own computer, connects to a free or paid AI brain, and lets the owner talk to the agent from WhatsApp.

Canonical site: https://wira.nibiashara.biz/
Plain-language guide: https://wira.nibiashara.biz/learn
Technical notes: https://wira.nibiashara.biz/nerd-stuff
Privacy: https://wira.nibiashara.biz/privacy
Terms: https://wira.nibiashara.biz/terms

Product summary:
- Name: Wira
- Company: Ni Biashara LLC
- Category: WhatsApp AI agent, personal AI agent, local agent
- Current public platform: macOS on Apple Silicon
- Windows status: coming soon after code signing and install smoke testing
- Price: $49 one-time Wira Local purchase
- Main value: Wira gives a nontechnical owner a familiar WhatsApp thread that becomes the front door to a real personal agent on their own computer.

How it works:
1. Download and open Wira on a Mac.
2. Choose a brain: a free provider tier, an existing ChatGPT subscription, or a private local model when the machine fits.
3. Pair WhatsApp through Linked Devices.
4. Send the first message to Wira from WhatsApp.

Important positioning:
- WhatsApp is the control surface, not the product.
- Wira is not a public auto-reply bot by default.
- Wira Local is owner-controlled and lives on the buyer's machine.
- The product starts simple and can grow into deeper local agent work later.
